title: 1937-12-12_Bombing_of_USS_Panay
shows: NEWSREEL 22 min (Universal, 1937): river gunboats on the Yangtze, Nanking - closest available film of the 1930s Yangtze gunboat world Judy lived in (HMS Ladybird/Bee were also attacked that day). Good: 1:00-12:00 river, gunboat decks, crew with binoculars; 14:00-16:00 burning/settling gunboat. AVOID 17:00-20:30 (wounded men).
license: Public domain (Universal Newsreel, PD per Internet Archive)
author: Universal Newsreel / Internet Archive

title: NPC-9208
shows: FILM 9:53 (captured Japanese newsreel, Feb 1942): Singapore under attack, smoke over the city, Japanese troops advancing, tanks - the fall of Singapore when Judy's ship fled. Soft quality; battle but no gore seen on contact sheet.
license: Public domain (captured enemy film, U.S. National Archives)
author: National Archives (NPC 9208) / Internet Archive
